text: This solution, KFS Comprehensive and Sectoral Implementation Plans for Landslide Prevention addresses natural catastrophe in Republic of Korea between Korea Forest Service (KFS), Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (MAFRA), Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT), Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE), and Cultural Heritage Administration. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
